task:
Manage applications using Helm.

Task 1 — Add the Bitnami repository and install a release:
  helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
  helm repo update
  helm install my-nginx bitnami/nginx --namespace helm-demo --create-namespace --set replicaCount=2

Task 2 — List all Helm releases in all namespaces:
  helm list -A

Task 3 — Generate a Helm template and save to file (exam pattern):
  helm template my-nginx bitnami/nginx --set replicaCount=3 > /opt/course/helm-template.yaml

Task 4 — Upgrade the release to change replica count:
  helm upgrade my-nginx bitnami/nginx --namespace helm-demo --set replicaCount=3

Task 5 — View upgrade history:
  helm history my-nginx -n helm-demo

Task 6 — Rollback to revision 1:
  helm rollback my-nginx 1 -n helm-demo

Verify:
  kubectl get pods -n helm-demo
  helm list -n helm-demo
hints: helm repo add <name> <url>  then helm repo update
helm template generates YAML without installing
detailed_hints: Helm releases are Kubernetes secrets of type helm.sh/release — stored in the release namespace
helm get values my-nginx -n helm-demo  shows current values
helm show values bitnami/nginx | grep replicaCount  shows default values

validators.description: Helm release secret exists in helm-demo

validators.command: kubectl get pods -n helm-demo --no-headers | grep -c Running
